highlights_headline: The upcoming SkiaSharp 4.157.0 updates the native engine to Skia m157 without changing the managed API surface.
highlights_body: Generated LibraryImport bindings also gain explicit calling-convention metadata. Native Graphite Metal integrations must account for the updated iOS and tvOS runtime minimum. HarfBuzzSharp advances to package revision 14.4.0.200; the native HarfBuzz engine remains 14.4.0.

breaking.title: Target iOS and tvOS 15 for Graphite Metal
breaking.body: Native Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15 or later; target those versions or newer when using that backend. Its macOS minimum remains 12. These native backend minimums do not replace higher managed or framework requirements.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled Skia engine to milestone 157 while preserving the m156 glyph-bounds guard. Managed wrappers and public signatures are unchanged.

LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching the existing DllImport and delegate paths. This addresses an ABI mismatch risk associated with reported Windows x86 stack growth; runtime validation of that symptom remains outstanding.
